story.body: You spent the morning making three rolls agree. Humphrey showed one change running through Gaunt, York, and the Queen. John required paper before mouths. You backed eightpence out of the stock for the copying. Humphrey marked each roll with the small sign. Nick spoke the new cue once and was sent into the yard. Edith put a stitch in the afternoon coat. The weight stayed on the rolls when you left.

story.body: You came in before the doors and read the bill on the post. You took the paint, went on, came off, and stayed in the tiring-house. The rope stayed on the bench. The dog stayed a Christmas story. You waited, still painted, until the yard was ready to be let out.
